goal: `mc deploy` and the merge rounds no longer wait for each other. A deploy holds the repository lease only for the seconds it takes to fast-forward `main` and read the sha that ships; the build and `npm run deploy` run on that fixed sha with the lease released, so a gate or merge round can land the next pull request while production is being built, and a deploy can start while a round is measuring. What a deploy ships is still exactly one sha, recorded before the spawn and verified live after it.

success_criteria.criterion: While `npm run deploy` is running under `mc deploy`, a `mc merge <repo> <pr>` round claims the repository lease and runs; while a merge round holds the lease, `mc deploy` waits for the fast-forward window rather than refusing, and ships the sha `main` stood on when it got its turn.
success_criteria.check: `tests/mc/commands/deploy.test.js`: a deploy whose spawn is held open releases the lease before the spawn starts (the fake spawn reads `readLease(PATH)` and sees it free); a deploy started against a held lease with a spawn that releases it a moment later goes through and records the sha read after the fast-forward; `tests/mc/repo-merge.test.js`: a merge round against a lease whose errand begins `deploy ` is not refused when the lease is gone by its claim.

success_criteria.criterion: The help text, the deploy row on the page and the refusal wording say what the lease now covers, and the deploy record is unchanged in shape.
success_criteria.check: `src/mc/help-text.js` § `mc deploy` no longer says the lease is held for the whole deploy; `tests/mc/deploys.test.js` green unchanged; `mc deploy --dry-run --json` output unchanged.

steps.title: The deploy's lease covers the fast-forward and the read of the sha, and nothing after
steps.done_when: In `src/mc/commands/deploy.js` the lease is claimed before `closeAbandoned` and the fast-forward and released right after `shipping` is read and `recordStart` has written its row, before `spawnDeploy`; the `finally` release becomes a guard that only releases a lease this process still holds; `tests/mc/commands/deploy.test.js` pins that the spawn runs with the lease free and that a throw after release does not release somebody else's lease; and the help text and refusal line say so.

steps.title: Two deploys still never overlap, and a deploy waits for a merge round's window instead of refusing
steps.done_when: A second `mc deploy` while one is running is refused with the running deploy's sha and start time (from `deploys.tsv`, not from the lease); a `mc deploy` that meets a held lease waits for it the way `mc merge` waits for the gate (`merge-step.js` `WAIT_STOPS`), up to eight minutes, printing who holds it and for what, then takes its window; `tests/mc/commands/deploy.test.js` pins both; the page's deploy section shows a running deploy from the record.
comments: deploys.tsv has a pid column (appended at the end; a file with exactly the previous header is upgraded when the next row is written). runningDeploy/deployAlive in deploys.js are now what keep two deploys apart; the lease wait in deploy.js reuses MERGE_POLL_MS/MERGE_WAIT_MS rather than waitTurn, which is merge-queue specific.
